name: Viewpoint-surrounding Hemisphere System
definition: A display system suitable for tabletop applications where viewpoints are created above the view volume where virtual objects are formed, based on multi-view technology composed of multiple projection optics.
summary: The Viewpoint-surrounding Hemisphere System is a tabletop volumetric display that projects light upward onto a hemispherical screen to create 360-degree viewpoints above the surface without crosstalk.
